description: This file defines the ServerRequest class implementing the PSR-7 ServerRequestInterface for handling HTTP server requests. It contains properties for server parameters, uploaded files, cookies, query parameters, parsed body, and attributes. It provides methods for getting and setting these properties, as well as for validation and immutability.

classes.name: ServerRequest
classes.description: Implements PSR-7 ServerRequestInterface, represents an HTTP server request with methods for accessing server parameters, uploaded files, cookies, query parameters, request body, attributes, and validation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new ServerRequest object with server parameters, uploaded files, URI, method, body, headers, cookies, query parameters, parsed body, and protocol version.

methods.name: getUploadedFiles
methods.description: Returns the array of uploaded files.

methods.name: withUploadedFiles
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the provided uploaded files.

methods.name: withCookieParams
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the provided cookie parameters.

methods.name: withQueryParams
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the provided query parameters.

methods.name: withParsedBody
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the provided parsed body data, validating its type.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Returns the value of a specific attribute or default if not set.

methods.name: withAttribute
methods.description: Returns a new instance with an added attribute.

methods.name: withoutAttribute
methods.description: Returns a new instance without the specified attribute.
